record.question: Lucknow session of the Indian National Congress in 1916 was chiefly significant because:
options: It decided to boycott foreign goods
The Moderates and Extremists were reunited at the session
It decided to adopt a more vigorous method of agitation against the British
It decided to launch massive movement under the leadership of Mahatma Gandhi
